text.KJV: Paul, an apostle, (not of men, neither by man, but by Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead;)
text.ASV: Paul, an apostle (not from men, neither through man, but through Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead),
text.WEB: Paul, an apostle (not from men, nor through man, but through Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead),

text.KJV: And all the brethren which are with me, unto the churches of Galatia:
text.ASV: and all the brethren that are with me, unto the churches of Galatia:
text.WEB: and all the brothers who are with me, to the assemblies of Galatia:

text.KJV: Grace be to you and peace from God the Father, and from our Lord Jesus Christ,
text.ASV: Grace to you and peace from God the Father, and our Lord Jesus Christ,
text.WEB: Grace to you and peace from God the Father, and our Lord Jesus Christ,

text.KJV: Who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us from this present evil world, according to the will of God and our Father:
text.ASV: who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us out of this present evil world, according to the will of our God and Father:
text.WEB: who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us out of this present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father—

text.KJV: To whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
text.ASV: to whom `be' the glory for ever and ever. Amen.
text.WEB: to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

text.KJV: I marvel that ye are so soon removed from him that called you into the grace of Christ unto another gospel:
text.ASV: I marvel that ye are so quickly removing from him that called you in the grace of Christ unto a different gospel;
text.WEB: I marvel that you are so quickly deserting him who called you in the grace of Christ to a different “good news”;

text.KJV: Which is not another; but there be some that trouble you, and would pervert the gospel of Christ.
text.ASV: which is not another `gospel' only there are some that trouble you, and would pervert the gospel of Christ.
text.WEB: and there isn’t another “good news.” Only there are some who trouble you, and want to pervert the Good News of Christ.

text.KJV: But though we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you, let him be accursed.
text.ASV: But though we, or an angel from heaven, should preach unto you any gospel other than that which we preached unto you, let him be anathema.
text.WEB: But even though we, or an angel from heaven, should preach to you any “good news” other than that which we preached to you, let him be cursed.

text.KJV: As we said before, so say I now again, if any man preach any other gospel unto you than that ye have received, let him be accursed.
text.ASV: As we have said before, so say I now again, if any man preacheth unto you any gospel other than that which ye received, let him be anathema.
text.WEB: As we have said before, so I now say again: if any man preaches to you any “good news” other than that which you received, let him be cursed.

text.KJV: For do I now persuade men, or God? or do I seek to please men? for if I yet pleased men, I should not be the servant of Christ.
text.ASV: For am I now seeking the favor of men, or of God? or am I striving to please men? if I were still pleasing men, I should not be a servant of Christ.
text.WEB: For am I now seeking the favor of men, or of God? Or am I striving to please men? For if I were still pleasing men, I wouldn’t be a servant of Christ.

text.KJV: But I certify you, brethren, that the gospel which was preached of me is not after man.
text.ASV: For I make known to you, brethren, as touching the gospel which was preached by me, that it is not after man.
text.WEB: But I make known to you, brothers, concerning the Good News which was preached by me, that it is not according to man.

text.KJV: For I neither received it of man, neither was I taught it, but by the revelation of Jesus Christ.
text.ASV: For neither did I receive it from man, nor was I taught it, but `it came to me' through revelation of Jesus Christ.
text.WEB: For neither did I receive it from man, nor was I taught it, but it came to me through revelation of Jesus Christ.

text.KJV: For ye have heard of my conversation in time past in the Jews' religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the church of God, and wasted it:
text.ASV: For ye have heard of my manner of life in time past in the Jews' religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the church of God, and made havoc of it:
text.WEB: For you have heard of my way of living in time past in the Jews’ religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the assembly of God, and ravaged it.

text.KJV: And profited in the Jews' religion above many my equals in mine own nation, being more exceedingly zealous of the traditions of my fathers.
text.ASV: and I advanced in the Jews' religion beyond many of mine own age among my countrymen, being more exceedingly zealous for the traditions of my fathers.
text.WEB: I advanced in the Jews’ religion beyond many of my own age among my countrymen, being more exceedingly zealous for the traditions of my fathers.

text.KJV: But when it pleased God, who separated me from my mother's womb, and called me by his grace,
text.ASV: But when it was the good pleasure of God, who separated me, `even' from my mother's womb, and called me through his grace,
text.WEB: But when it was the good pleasure of God, who separated me from my mother’s womb, and called me through his grace,

text.KJV: To reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the heathen; immediately I conferred not with flesh and blood:
text.ASV: to reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the Gentiles; straightway I conferred not with flesh and blood:
text.WEB: to reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the Gentiles, I didn’t immediately confer with flesh and blood,

text.KJV: Neither went I up to Jerusalem to them which were apostles before me; but I went into Arabia, and returned again unto Damascus.
text.ASV: neither went I up to Jerusalem to them that were apostles before me: but I went away into Arabia; and again I returned unto Damascus.
text.WEB: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those who were apostles before me, but I went away into Arabia. Then I returned to Damascus.

text.KJV: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to see Peter, and abode with him fifteen days.
text.ASV: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to visit Cephas, and tarried with him fifteen days.
text.WEB: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to visit Peter, and stayed with him fifteen days.

text.KJV: But other of the apostles saw I none, save James the Lord's brother.
text.ASV: But other of the apostles saw I none, save James the Lord's brother.
text.WEB: But of the other apostles I saw no one, except James, the Lord’s brother.

text.KJV: Now the things which I write unto you, behold, before God, I lie not.
text.ASV: Now touching the things which I write unto you, behold, before God, I lie not.
text.WEB: Now about the things which I write to you, behold, before God, I’m not lying.

text.KJV: Afterwards I came into the regions of Syria and Cilicia;
text.ASV: Then I came unto the regions of Syria and Cilicia.
text.WEB: Then I came to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.

text.KJV: And was unknown by face unto the churches of Judaea which were in Christ:
text.ASV: And I was still unknown by face unto the churches of Judaea which were in Christ:
text.WEB: I was still unknown by face to the assemblies of Judea which were in Christ,

text.KJV: But they had heard only, That he which persecuted us in times past now preacheth the faith which once he destroyed.
text.ASV: but they only heard say, He that once persecuted us now preacheth the faith of which he once made havoc;
text.WEB: but they only heard: “He who once persecuted us now preaches the faith that he once tried to destroy.”

text.KJV: And they glorified God in me.
text.ASV: and they glorified God in me.
text.WEB: And they glorified God in me.

text.KJV: Then fourteen years after I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, and took Titus with me also.
text.ASV: Then after the space of fourteen years I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking Titus also with me.
text.WEB: Then after a period of fourteen years I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking Titus also with me.

text.KJV: And I went up by revelation, and communicated unto them that gospel which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately to them which were of reputation, lest by any means I should run, or had run, in vain.
text.ASV: And I went up by revelation; and I laid before them the gospel which I preach among the Gentiles but privately before them who were of repute, lest by any means I should be running, or had run, in vain.
text.WEB: I went up by revelation, and I laid before them the Good News which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately before those who were respected, for fear that I might be running, or had run, in vain.

text.KJV: But neither Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised:
text.ASV: But not even Titus who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised:
text.WEB: But not even Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised.

text.KJV: And that because of false brethren unawares brought in, who came in privily to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage:
text.ASV: and that because of the false brethren privily brought in, who came in privily to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage:
text.WEB: This was because of the false brothers secretly brought in, who stole in to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage;

text.KJV: To whom we gave place by subjection, no, not for an hour; that the truth of the gospel might continue with you.
text.ASV: to whom we gave place in the way of subjection, no, not for an hour; that the truth of the gospel might continue with you.
text.WEB: to whom we gave no place in the way of subjection, not for an hour, that the truth of the Good News might continue with you.

text.KJV: But of these who seemed to be somewhat, (whatsoever they were, it maketh no matter to me: God accepteth no man's person:) for they who seemed to be somewhat in conference added nothing to me:
text.ASV: But from those who were reputed to be somewhat (whatsoever they were, it maketh no matter to me: God accepteth not man's person)-- they, I say, who were of repute imparted nothing to me:
text.WEB: But from those who were reputed to be important (whatever they were, it makes no difference to me; God doesn’t show partiality to man)—they, I say, who were respected imparted nothing to me,

text.KJV: But contrariwise, when they saw that the gospel of the uncircumcision was committed unto me, as the gospel of the circumcision was unto Peter;
text.ASV: but contrariwise, when they saw that I had been intrusted with the gospel of the uncircumcision, even as Peter with `the gospel' of the circumcision
text.WEB: but to the contrary, when they saw that I had been entrusted with the Good News for the uncircumcised, even as Peter with the Good News for the circumcised

text.KJV: (For he that wrought effectually in Peter to the apostleship of the circumcision, the same was mighty in me toward the Gentiles:)
text.ASV: (for he that wrought for Peter unto the apostleship of the circumcision wrought for me also unto the Gentiles);
text.WEB: (for he who worked through Peter in the apostleship with the circumcised also worked through me with the Gentiles);

text.KJV: And when James, Cephas, and John, who seemed to be pillars, perceived the grace that was given unto me, they gave to me and Barnabas the right hands of fellowship; that we should go unto the heathen, and they unto the circumcision.
text.ASV: and when they perceived the grace that was given unto me, James and Cephas and John, they who were reputed to be pillars, gave to me and Barnabas the right hands of fellowship, that we should go unto the Gentiles, and they unto the circumcision;
text.WEB: and when they perceived the grace that was given to me, James and Cephas and John, they who were reputed to be pillars, gave to me and Barnabas the right hand of fellowship, that we should go to the Gentiles, and they to the circumcision.

text.KJV: Only they would that we should remember the poor; the same which I also was forward to do.
text.ASV: only `they would' that we should remember the poor; which very thing I was also zealous to do.
text.WEB: They only asked us to remember the poor—which very thing I was also zealous to do.

text.KJV: But when Peter was come to Antioch, I withstood him to the face, because he was to be blamed.
text.ASV: But when Cephas came to Antioch, I resisted him to the face, because he stood condemned.
text.WEB: But when Peter came to Antioch, I resisted him to his face, because he stood condemned.

text.KJV: For before that certain came from James, he did eat with the Gentiles: but when they were come, he withdrew and separated himself, fearing them which were of the circumcision.
text.ASV: For before that certain came from James, he ate with the Gentiles; but when they came, he drew back and separated himself, fearing them that were of the circumcision.
text.WEB: For before some people came from James, he ate with the Gentiles. But when they came, he drew back and separated himself, fearing those who were of the circumcision.

text.KJV: And the other Jews dissembled likewise with him; insomuch that Barnabas also was carried away with their dissimulation.
text.ASV: And the rest of the Jews dissembled likewise with him; insomuch that even Barnabas was carried away with their dissimulation.
text.WEB: And the rest of the Jews joined him in his hypocrisy; so that even Barnabas was carried away with their hypocrisy.

text.KJV: But when I saw that they walked not uprightly according to the truth of the gospel, I said unto Peter before them all, If thou, being a Jew, livest after the manner of Gentiles, and not as do the Jews, why compellest thou the Gentiles to live as do the Jews?
text.ASV: But when I saw that they walked not uprightly according to the truth of the gospel, I said unto Cephas before `them' all, If thou, being a Jew, livest as do the Gentiles, and not as do the Jews, how compellest thou the Gentiles to live as do the Jews?
text.WEB: But when I saw that they didn’t walk uprightly according to the truth of the Good News, I said to Peter before them all, “If you, being a Jew, live as the Gentiles do, and not as the Jews do, why do you compel the Gentiles to live as the Jews do?

text.KJV: We who are Jews by nature, and not sinners of the Gentiles,
text.ASV: We being Jews by nature, and not sinners of the Gentiles,
text.WEB: “We, being Jews by nature, and not Gentile sinners,

text.KJV: Knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law, but by the faith of Jesus Christ, even we have believed in Jesus Christ, that we might be justified by the faith of Christ, and not by the works of the law: for by the works of the law shall no flesh be justified.
text.ASV: yet knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law but through faith in Jesus Christ, even we believed on Christ Jesus, that we might be justified by faith in Christ, and not by the works of the law: because by the works of the law shall no flesh be justified.
text.WEB: yet knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law but through faith in Jesus Christ, even we believed in Christ Jesus, that we might be justified by faith in Christ, and not by the works of the law, because no flesh will be justified by the works of the law.

text.KJV: But if, while we seek to be justified by Christ, we ourselves also are found sinners, is therefore Christ the minister of sin? God forbid.
text.ASV: But if, while we sought to be justified in Christ, we ourselves also were found sinners, is Christ a minister of sin? God forbid.
text.WEB: But if, while we sought to be justified in Christ, we ourselves also were found sinners, is Christ a servant of sin? Certainly not!

text.KJV: For if I build again the things which I destroyed, I make myself a transgressor.
text.ASV: For if I build up again those things which I destroyed, I prove myself a transgressor.
text.WEB: For if I build up again those things which I destroyed, I prove myself a law-breaker.

text.KJV: For I through the law am dead to the law, that I might live unto God.
text.ASV: For I through the law died unto the law, that I might live unto God.
text.WEB: For I, through the law, died to the law, that I might live to God.

text.KJV: I am crucified with Christ: neverthless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me.
text.ASV: I have been crucified with Christ; and it is no longer I that live, but Christ living in me: and that `life' which I now live in the flesh I live in faith, `the faith' which is in the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself up for me.
text.WEB: I have been crucified with Christ, and it is no longer I that live, but Christ lives in me. That life which I now live in the flesh, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself up for me.

text.KJV: I do not frustrate the grace of God: for if righteousness come by the law, then Christ is dead in vain.
text.ASV: I do not make void the grace of God: for if righteousness is through the law, then Christ died for nought.
text.WEB: I don’t reject the grace of God. For if righteousness is through the law, then Christ died for nothing!”

text.KJV: O foolish Galatians, who hath bewitched you, that ye should not obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ hath been evidently set forth, crucified among you?
text.ASV: O foolish Galatians, who did bewitch you, before whose eyes Jesus Christ was openly set forth crucified?
text.WEB: Foolish Galatians, who has bewitched you not to obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ was openly portrayed among you as crucified?

text.KJV: This only would I learn of you, Received ye the Spirit by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
text.ASV: This only would I learn from you. Received ye the Spirit by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
text.WEB: I just want to learn this from you: Did you receive the Spirit by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?

text.KJV: Are ye so foolish? having begun in the Spirit, are ye now made perfect by the flesh?
text.ASV: Are ye so foolish? having begun in the Spirit, are ye now perfected in the flesh?
text.WEB: Are you so foolish? Having begun in the Spirit, are you now completed in the flesh?

text.KJV: Have ye suffered so many things in vain? if it be yet in vain.
text.ASV: Did ye suffer so many things in vain? if it be indeed in vain.
text.WEB: Did you suffer so many things in vain, if it is indeed in vain?

text.KJV: He therefore that ministereth to you the Spirit, and worketh miracles among you, doeth he it by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
text.ASV: He therefore that supplieth to you the Spirit, and worketh miracles among you, `doeth he it' by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
text.WEB: He therefore who supplies the Spirit to you, and does miracles among you, does he do it by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?

text.KJV: Even as Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.
text.ASV: Even as Abraham believed God, and it was reckoned unto him for righteousness.
text.WEB: Even as Abraham “believed God, and it was counted to him for righteousness.”

text.KJV: Know ye therefore that they which are of faith, the same are the children of Abraham.
text.ASV: Know therefore that they that are of faith, the same are sons of Abraham.
text.WEB: Know therefore that those who are of faith, the same are children of Abraham.

text.KJV: And the scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the heathen through faith, preached before the gospel unto Abraham, saying, In thee shall all nations be blessed.
text.ASV: And the scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, preached the gospel beforehand unto Abraham, `saying,' In thee shall all the nations be blessed.
text.WEB: The Scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, preached the Good News beforehand to Abraham, saying, “In you all the nations will be blessed.”; ;

text.KJV: So then they which be of faith are blessed with faithful Abraham.
text.ASV: So then they that are of faith are blessed with the faithful Abraham.
text.WEB: So then, those who are of faith are blessed with the faithful Abraham.

text.KJV: For as many as are of the works of the law are under the curse: for it is written, Cursed is every one that continueth not in all things which are written in the book of the law to do them.
text.ASV: For as many as are of the works of the law are under a curse: for it is written, Cursed is every one who continueth not in all things that are written in the book of the law, to do them.
text.WEB: For as many as are of the works of the law are under a curse. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who doesn’t continue in all things that are written in the book of the law, to do them.”

text.KJV: But that no man is justified by the law in the sight of God, it is evident: for, The just shall live by faith.
text.ASV: Now that no man is justified by the law before God, is evident: for, The righteous shall live by faith;
text.WEB: Now that no man is justified by the law before God is evident, for, “The righteous will live by faith.”

text.KJV: And the law is not of faith: but, The man that doeth them shall live in them.
text.ASV: and the law is not of faith; but, He that doeth them shall live in them.
text.WEB: The law is not of faith, but, “The man who does them will live by them.”

text.KJV: Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us: for it is written, Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree:
text.ASV: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us; for it is written, Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree:
text.WEB: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who hangs on a tree,”

text.KJV: That the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Jesus Christ; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.
text.ASV: that upon the Gentiles might come the blessing of Abraham in Christ Jesus; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.
text.WEB: that the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Christ Jesus; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.

text.KJV: Brethren, I speak after the manner of men; Though it be but a man's covenant, yet if it be confirmed, no man disannulleth, or addeth thereto.
text.ASV: Brethren, I speak after the manner of men: Though it be but a man's covenant, yet when it hath been confirmed, no one maketh it void, or addeth thereto.
text.WEB: Brothers, speaking of human terms, though it is only a man’s covenant, yet when it has been confirmed, no one makes it void, or adds to it.

text.KJV: Now to Abraham and his seed were the promises made. He saith not, And to seeds, as of many; but as of one, And to thy seed, which is Christ.
text.ASV: Now to Abraham were the promises spoken, and to his seed. He saith not, And to seeds, as of many; but as of one, And to thy seed, which is Christ.
text.WEB: Now the promises were spoken to Abraham and to his offspring. He doesn’t say, “To descendants”, as of many, but as of one, “To your offspring”,; ; which is Christ.

text.KJV: And this I say, that the covenant, that was confirmed before of God in Christ, the law, which was four hundred and thirty years after, cannot disannul, that it should make the promise of none effect.
text.ASV: Now this I say: A covenant confirmed beforehand by God, the law, which came four hundred and thirty years after, doth not disannul, so as to make the promise of none effect.
text.WEB: Now I say this: A covenant confirmed beforehand by God in Christ, the law, which came four hundred thirty years after, does not annul, so as to make the promise of no effect.

text.KJV: For if the inheritance be of the law, it is no more of promise: but God gave it to Abraham by promise.
text.ASV: For if the inheritance is of the law, it is no more of promise: but God hath granted it to Abraham by promise.
text.WEB: For if the inheritance is of the law, it is no more of promise; but God has granted it to Abraham by promise.

text.KJV: Wherefore then serveth the law? It was added because of transgressions, till the seed should come to whom the promise was made; and it was ordained by angels in the hand of a mediator.
text.ASV: What then is the law? It was added because of transgressions, till the seed should come to whom the promise hath been made; `and it was' ordained through angels by the hand of a mediator.
text.WEB: Then why is there the law? It was added because of transgressions, until the offspring should come to whom the promise has been made. It was ordained through angels by the hand of a mediator.

text.KJV: Now a mediator is not a mediator of one, but God is one.
text.ASV: Now a mediator is not `a mediator' of one; but God is one.
text.WEB: Now a mediator is not between one, but God is one.

text.KJV: Is the law then against the promises of God? God forbid: for if there had been a law given which could have given life, verily righteousness should have been by the law.
text.ASV: Is the law then against the promises of God? God forbid: for if there had been a law given which could make alive, verily righteousness would have been of the law.
text.WEB: Is the law then against the promises of God? Certainly not! For if there had been a law given which could make alive, most certainly righteousness would have been of the law.

text.KJV: But the scripture hath concluded all under sin, that the promise by faith of Jesus Christ might be given to them that believe.
text.ASV: But the scriptures shut up all things under sin, that the promise by faith in Jesus Christ might be given to them that believe.
text.WEB: But the Scriptures imprisoned all things under sin, that the promise by faith in Jesus Christ might be given to those who believe.

text.KJV: But before faith came, we were kept under the law, shut up unto the faith which should afterwards be revealed.
text.ASV: But before faith came, we were kept in ward under the law, shut up unto the faith which should afterwards be revealed.
text.WEB: But before faith came, we were kept in custody under the law, confined for the faith which should afterwards be revealed.

text.KJV: Wherefore the law was our schoolmaster to bring us unto Christ, that we might be justified by faith.
text.ASV: So that the law is become our tutor `to bring us' unto Christ, that we might be justified by faith.
text.WEB: So that the law has become our tutor to bring us to Christ, that we might be justified by faith.

text.KJV: But after that faith is come, we are no longer under a schoolmaster.
text.ASV: But now faith that is come, we are no longer under a tutor.
text.WEB: But now that faith has come, we are no longer under a tutor.

text.KJV: For ye are all the children of God by faith in Christ Jesus.
text.ASV: For ye are all sons of God, through faith, in Christ Jesus.
text.WEB: For you are all children of God, through faith in Christ Jesus.

text.KJV: For as many of you as have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ.
text.ASV: For as many of you as were baptized into Christ did put on Christ.
text.WEB: For as many of you as were baptized into Christ have put on Christ.

text.KJV: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: for ye are all one in Christ Jesus.
text.ASV: There can be neither Jew nor Greek, there can be neither bond nor free, there can be no male and female; for ye all are one `man' in Christ Jesus.
text.WEB: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free man, there is neither male nor female; for you are all one in Christ Jesus.

text.KJV: And if ye be Christ's, then are ye Abraham's seed, and heirs according to the promise.
text.ASV: And if ye are Christ's, then are ye Abraham's seed, heirs according to promise.
text.WEB: If you are Christ’s, then you are Abraham’s offspring and heirs according to promise.

text.KJV: Now I say, That the heir, as long as he is a child, differeth nothing from a servant, though he be lord of all;
text.ASV: But I say that so long as the heir is a child, he differeth nothing from a bondservant though he is lord of all;
text.WEB: But I say that so long as the heir is a child, he is no different from a bondservant, though he is lord of all;

text.KJV: But is under tutors and governors until the time appointed of the father.
text.ASV: but is under guardians and stewards until the day appointed of the father.
text.WEB: but is under guardians and stewards until the day appointed by the father.

text.KJV: Even so we, when we were children, were in bondage under the elements of the world:
text.ASV: So we also, when we were children, were held in bondage under the rudiments of the world:
text.WEB: So we also, when we were children, were held in bondage under the elemental principles of the world.

text.KJV: But when the fulness of the time was come, God sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,
text.ASV: but when the fulness of the time came, God sent forth his Son, born of a woman, born under the law,
text.WEB: But when the fullness of the time came, God sent out his Son, born to a woman, born under the law,

text.KJV: To redeem them that were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of sons.
text.ASV: that he might redeem them that were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of sons.
text.WEB: that he might redeem those who were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of children.

text.KJV: And because ye are sons, God hath sent forth the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, Abba, Father.
text.ASV: And because ye are sons, God sent forth the Spirit of his Son into our hearts, crying, Abba, Father.
text.WEB: And because you are children, God sent out the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, “Abba, Father!”

text.KJV: Wherefore thou art no more a servant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.
text.ASV: So that thou art no longer a bondservant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir through God.
text.WEB: So you are no longer a bondservant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.

text.KJV: Howbeit then, when ye knew not God, ye did service unto them which by nature are no gods.
text.ASV: Howbeit at that time, not knowing God, ye were in bondage to them that by nature are no gods:
text.WEB: However at that time, not knowing God, you were in bondage to those who by nature are not gods.

text.KJV: But now, after that ye have known God, or rather are known of God, how turn ye again to the weak and beggarly elements, whereunto ye desire again to be in bondage?
text.ASV: but now that ye have come to know God, or rather to be known by God, how turn ye back again to the weak and beggarly rudiments, whereunto ye desire to be in bondage over again?
text.WEB: But now that you have come to know God, or rather to be known by God, why do you turn back again to the weak and miserable elemental principles, to which you desire to be in bondage all over again?

text.KJV: Ye observe days, and months, and times, and years.
text.ASV: Ye observe days, and months, and seasons, and years.
text.WEB: You observe days, months, seasons, and years.

text.KJV: I am afraid of you, lest I have bestowed upon you labour in vain.
text.ASV: I am afraid of you, lest by any means I have bestowed labor upon you in vain.
text.WEB: I am afraid for you, that I might have wasted my labor for you.

text.KJV: Brethren, I beseech you, be as I am; for I am as ye are: ye have not injured me at all.
text.ASV: I beseech you, brethren, become as I `am', for I also `am become' as ye `are'. Ye did me no wrong:
text.WEB: I beg you, brothers, become as I am, for I also have become as you are. You did me no wrong,

text.KJV: Ye know how through infirmity of the flesh I preached the gospel unto you at the first.
text.ASV: but ye know that because of an infirmity of the flesh I preached the gospel unto you the first time:
text.WEB: but you know that because of weakness in the flesh I preached the Good News to you the first time.

text.KJV: And my temptation which was in my flesh ye despised not, nor rejected; but received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.
text.ASV: and that which was a temptation to you in my flesh ye despised not, nor rejected; but ye received me as an angel of God, `even' as Christ Jesus.
text.WEB: That which was a temptation to you in my flesh, you didn’t despise nor reject; but you received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.

text.KJV: Where is then the blessedness ye spake of? for I bear you record, that, if it had been possible, ye would have plucked out your own eyes, and have given them to me.
text.ASV: Where then is that gratulation of yourselves? for I bear you witness, that, if possible, ye would have plucked out your eyes and given them to me.
text.WEB: What was the blessing you enjoyed? For I testify to you that, if possible, you would have plucked out your eyes and given them to me.

text.KJV: Am I therefore become your enemy, because I tell you the truth?
text.ASV: So then am I become your enemy, by telling you the truth?
text.WEB: So then, have I become your enemy by telling you the truth?

text.KJV: They zealously affect you, but not well; yea, they would exclude you, that ye might affect them.
text.ASV: They zealously seek you in no good way; nay, they desire to shut you out, that ye may seek them.
text.WEB: They zealously seek you in no good way. No, they desire to alienate you, that you may seek them.

text.KJV: But it is good to be zealously affected always in a good thing, and not only when I am present with you.
text.ASV: But it is good to be zealously sought in a good matter at all times, and not only when I am present with you.
text.WEB: But it is always good to be zealous in a good cause, and not only when I am present with you.

text.KJV: My little children, of whom I travail in birth again until Christ be formed in you,
text.ASV: My little children, of whom I am again in travail until Christ be formed in you--
text.WEB: My little children, of whom I am again in travail until Christ is formed in you—

text.KJV: I desire to be present with you now, and to change my voice; for I stand in doubt of you.
text.ASV: but I could wish to be present with you now, and to change my tone; for I am perplexed about you.
text.WEB: but I could wish to be present with you now, and to change my tone, for I am perplexed about you.

text.KJV: Tell me, ye that desire to be under the law, do ye not hear the law?
text.ASV: Tell me, ye that desire to be under the law, do ye not hear the law?
text.WEB: Tell me, you that desire to be under the law, don’t you listen to the law?

text.KJV: For it is written, that Abraham had two sons, the one by a bondmaid, the other by a freewoman.
text.ASV: For it is written, that Abraham had two sons, one by the handmaid, and one by the freewoman.
text.WEB: For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the servant, and one by the free woman.

text.KJV: But he who was of the bondwoman was born after the flesh; but he of the freewoman was by promise.
text.ASV: Howbeit the `son' by the handmaid is born after the flesh; but the `son' by the freewoman `is born' through promise.
text.WEB: However, the son by the servant was born according to the flesh, but the son by the free woman was born through promise.

text.KJV: Which things are an allegory: for these are the two covenants; the one from the mount Sinai, which gendereth to bondage, which is Agar.
text.ASV: Which things contain an allegory: for these `women' are two covenants; one from mount Sinai, bearing children unto bondage, which is Hagar.
text.WEB: These things contain an allegory, for these are two covenants. One is from Mount Sinai, bearing children to bondage, which is Hagar.

text.KJV: For this Agar is mount Sinai in Arabia, and answereth to Jerusalem which now is, and is in bondage with her children.
text.ASV: Now this Hagar is mount Sinai in Arabia and answereth to the Jerusalem that now is: for she is in bondage with her children.
text.WEB: For this Hagar is Mount Sinai in Arabia, and answers to the Jerusalem that exists now, for she is in bondage with her children.

text.KJV: But Jerusalem which is above is free, which is the mother of us all.
text.ASV: But the Jerusalem that is above is free, which is our mother.
text.WEB: But the Jerusalem that is above is free, which is the mother of us all.

text.KJV: For it is written, Rejoice, thou barren that bearest not; break forth and cry, thou that travailest not: for the desolate hath many more children than she which hath an husband.
text.ASV: For it is written, Rejoice, thou barren that bearest not; Break forth and cry, thou that travailest not: For more are the children of the desolate than of her that hath the husband.
text.WEB: For it is written, “Rejoice, you barren who don’t bear. Break out and shout, you that don’t travail. For more are the children of the desolate than of her who has a husband.”

text.KJV: Now we, brethren, as Isaac was, are the children of promise.
text.ASV: Now we, brethren, as Isaac was, are children of promise.
text.WEB: Now we, brothers, as Isaac was, are children of promise.

text.KJV: But as then he that was born after the flesh persecuted him that was born after the Spirit, even so it is now.
text.ASV: But as then he that was born after the flesh persecuted him `that was born' after the Spirit, so also it is now.
text.WEB: But as then, he who was born according to the flesh persecuted him who was born according to the Spirit, so also it is now.

text.KJV: Nevertheless what saith the scripture? Cast out the bondwoman and her son: for the son of the bondwoman shall not be heir with the son of the freewoman.
text.ASV: Howbeit what saith the scripture? Cast out the handmaid and her son: for the son of the handmaid shall not inherit with the son of the freewoman.
text.WEB: However what does the Scripture say? “Throw out the servant and her son, for the son of the servant will not inherit with the son of the free woman.”

text.KJV: So then, brethren, we are not children of the bondwoman, but of the free.
text.ASV: Wherefore, brethren, we are not children of a handmaid, but of the freewoman.
text.WEB: So then, brothers, we are not children of a servant, but of the free woman.

text.KJV: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.
text.ASV: For freedom did Christ set us free: stand fast therefore, and be not entangled again in a yoke of bondage.
text.WEB: Stand firm therefore in the liberty by which Christ has made us free, and don’t be entangled again with a yoke of bondage.

text.KJV: Behold, I Paul say unto you, that if ye be circumcised, Christ shall profit you nothing.
text.ASV: Behold, I Paul say unto you, that, if ye receive circumcision, Christ will profit you nothing.
text.WEB: Behold, I, Paul, tell you that if you receive circumcision, Christ will profit you nothing.

text.KJV: For I testify again to every man that is circumcised, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.
text.ASV: Yea, I testify again to every man that receiveth circumcision, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.
text.WEB: Yes, I testify again to every man who receives circumcision, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.

text.KJV: Christ is become of no effect unto you, whosoever of you are justified by the law; ye are fallen from grace.
text.ASV: Ye are severed from Christ, ye would be justified by the law; ye are fallen away from grace.
text.WEB: You are alienated from Christ, you who desire to be justified by the law. You have fallen away from grace.

text.KJV: For we through the Spirit wait for the hope of righteousness by faith.
text.ASV: For we through the Spirit by faith wait for the hope of righteousness.
text.WEB: For we, through the Spirit, by faith wait for the hope of righteousness.

text.KJV: For in Jesus Christ neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision; but faith which worketh by love.
text.ASV: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision availeth anything, nor uncircumcision; but faith working through love.
text.WEB: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision amounts to anything, nor uncircumcision, but faith working through love.

text.KJV: Ye did run well; who did hinder you that ye should not obey the truth?
text.ASV: Ye were running well; who hindered you that ye should not obey the truth?
text.WEB: You were running well! Who interfered with you that you should not obey the truth?

text.KJV: This persuasion cometh not of him that calleth you.
text.ASV: This persuasion `came' not of him that calleth you.
text.WEB: This persuasion is not from him who calls you.

text.KJV: A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.
text.ASV: A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.
text.WEB: A little yeast grows through the whole lump.

text.KJV: I have confidence in you through the Lord, that ye will be none otherwise minded: but he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment, whosoever he be.
text.ASV: I have confidence to you-ward in the Lord, that ye will be none otherwise minded: but he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment, whosoever he be.
text.WEB: I have confidence toward you in the Lord that you will think no other way. But he who troubles you will bear his judgment, whoever he is.

text.KJV: And I, brethren, if I yet preach circumcision, why do I yet suffer persecution? then is the offence of the cross ceased.
text.ASV: But I, brethren, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still persecuted? then hath the stumbling-block of the cross been done away.
text.WEB: But I, brothers, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still persecuted? Then the stumbling block of the cross has been removed.

text.KJV: I would they were even cut off which trouble you.
text.ASV: I would that they that unsettle you would even go beyond circumcision.
text.WEB: I wish that those who disturb you would cut themselves off.

text.KJV: For, brethren, ye have been called unto liberty; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love serve one another.
text.ASV: For ye, brethren, were called for freedom; only `use' not your freedom for an occasion to the flesh, but through love be servants one to another.
text.WEB: For you, brothers, were called for freedom. Only don’t use your freedom for gain to the flesh, but through love be servants to one another.

text.KJV: For all the law is fulfilled in one word, even in this; Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
text.ASV: For the whole law is fulfilled in one word, `even' in this: Thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself.
text.WEB: For the whole law is fulfilled in one word, in this: “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”

text.KJV: But if ye bite and devour one another, take heed that ye be not consumed one of another.
text.ASV: But if ye bite and devour one another, take heed that ye be not consumed one of another.
text.WEB: But if you bite and devour one another, be careful that you don’t consume one another.

text.KJV: This I say then, Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.
text.ASV: But I say, walk by the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.
text.WEB: But I say, walk by the Spirit, and you won’t fulfill the lust of the flesh.

text.KJV: For the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh: and these are contrary the one to the other: so that ye cannot do the things that ye would.
text.ASV: For the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; for these are contrary the one to the other; that ye may not do the things that ye would.
text.WEB: For the flesh lusts against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; and these are contrary to one another, that you may not do the things that you desire.

text.KJV: But if ye be led of the Spirit, ye are not under the law.
text.ASV: But if ye are led by the Spirit, ye are not under the law.
text.WEB: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.

text.KJV: Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are these; Adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness,
text.ASV: Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are `these': fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness,
text.WEB: Now the deeds of the flesh are obvious, which are: adultery, sexual immorality, uncleanness, lustfulness,

text.KJV: Idolatry, witchcraft, hatred, variance, emulations, wrath, strife, seditions, heresies,
text.ASV: idolatry, sorcery, enmities, strife, jealousies, wraths, factions, divisions, parties,
text.WEB: idolatry, sorcery, hatred, strife, jealousies, outbursts of anger, rivalries, divisions, heresies,

text.KJV: Envyings, murders, drunkenness, revellings, and such like: of the which I tell you before, as I have also told you in time past, that they which do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God.
text.ASV: envyings, drunkenness, revellings, and such like; of which I forewarn you, even as I did forewarn you, that they who practise such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God.
text.WEB: envy, murders, drunkenness, orgies, and things like these; of which I forewarn you, even as I also forewarned you, that those who practice such things will not inherit God’s Kingdom.

text.KJV: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,
text.ASV: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, kindness, goodness, faithfulness,
text.WEB: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,

text.KJV: Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.
text.ASV: meekness, self-control; against such there is no law.
text.WEB: gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.

text.KJV: And they that are Christ's have crucified the flesh with the affections and lusts.
text.ASV: And they that are of Christ Jesus have crucified the flesh with the passions and the lusts thereof.
text.WEB: Those who belong to Christ have crucified the flesh with its passions and lusts.

text.KJV: If we live in the Spirit, let us also walk in the Spirit.
text.ASV: If we live by the Spirit, by the Spirit let us also walk.
text.WEB: If we live by the Spirit, let’s also walk by the Spirit.

text.KJV: Let us not be desirous of vain glory, provoking one another, envying one another.
text.ASV: Let us not become vainglorious, provoking one another, envying one another.
text.WEB: Let’s not become conceited, provoking one another, and envying one another.

text.KJV: Brethren, if a man be overtaken in a fault, ye which are spiritual, restore such an one in the spirit of meekness; considering thyself, lest thou also be tempted.
text.ASV: Brethren, even if a man be overtaken in any trespass, ye who are spiritual, restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness; looking to thyself, lest thou also be tempted.
text.WEB: Brothers, even if a man is caught in some fault, you who are spiritual must restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness; looking to yourself so that you also aren’t tempted.

text.KJV: Bear ye one another's burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.
text.ASV: Bear ye one another's burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.
text.WEB: Bear one another’s burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.

text.KJV: For if a man think himself to be something, when he is nothing, he deceiveth himself.
text.ASV: For if a man thinketh himself to be something when he is nothing, he deceiveth himself.
text.WEB: For if a man thinks himself to be something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.

text.KJV: But let every man prove his own work, and then shall he have rejoicing in himself alone, and not in another.
text.ASV: But let each man prove his own work, and then shall he have his glorying in regard of himself alone, and not of his neighbor.
text.WEB: But let each man examine his own work, and then he will have reason to boast in himself, and not in someone else.

text.KJV: For every man shall bear his own burden.
text.ASV: For each man shall bear his own burden.
text.WEB: For each man will bear his own burden.

text.KJV: Let him that is taught in the word communicate unto him that teacheth in all good things.
text.ASV: But let him that is taught in the word communicate unto him that teacheth in all good things.
text.WEB: But let him who is taught in the word share all good things with him who teaches.

text.KJV: Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.
text.ASV: Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.
text.WEB: Don’t be deceived. God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.

text.KJV: For he that soweth to his flesh shall of the flesh reap corruption; but he that soweth to the Spirit shall of the Spirit reap life everlasting.
text.ASV: For he that soweth unto his own flesh shall of the flesh reap corruption; but he that soweth unto the Spirit shall of the Spirit reap eternal life.
text.WEB: For he who sows to his own flesh will from the flesh reap corruption. But he who sows to the Spirit will from the Spirit reap eternal life.

text.KJV: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.
text.ASV: And let us not be weary in well-doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.
text.WEB: Let us not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season, if we don’t give up.

text.KJV: As we have therefore opportunity, let us do good unto all men, especially unto them who are of the household of faith.
text.ASV: So then, as we have opportunity, let us work that which is good toward all men, and especially toward them that are of the household of the faith.
text.WEB: So then, as we have opportunity, let’s do what is good toward all men, and especially toward those who are of the household of the faith.

text.KJV: Ye see how large a letter I have written unto you with mine own hand.
text.ASV: See with how large letters I write unto you with mine own hand.
text.WEB: See with what large letters I write to you with my own hand.

text.KJV: As many as desire to make a fair shew in the flesh, they constrain you to be circumcised; only lest they should suffer persecution for the cross of Christ.
text.ASV: As many as desire to make a fair show in the flesh, they compel you to be circumcised; only that they may not be persecuted for the cross of Christ.
text.WEB: As many as desire to make a good impression in the flesh compel you to be circumcised; just so they may not be persecuted for the cross of Christ.

text.KJV: For neither they themselves who are circumcised keep the law; but desire to have you circumcised, that they may glory in your flesh.
text.ASV: For not even they who receive circumcision do themselves keep the law; but they desire to have you circumcised, that they may glory in your flesh.
text.WEB: For even they who receive circumcision don’t keep the law themselves, but they desire to have you circumcised, that they may boast in your flesh.

text.KJV: But God forbid that I should glory, save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom the world is crucified unto me, and I unto the world.
text.ASV: But far be it from me to glory, save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world hath been crucified unto me, and I unto the world.
text.WEB: But far be it from me to boast, except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.

text.KJV: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision, but a new creature.
text.ASV: For neither is circumcision anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creature.
text.WEB: For in Christ Jesus neither is circumcision anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creation.

text.KJV: And as many as walk according to this rule, peace be on them, and mercy, and upon the Israel of God.
text.ASV: And as many as shall walk by this rule, peace `be' upon them, and mercy, and upon the Israel of God.
text.WEB: As many as walk by this rule, peace and mercy be on them, and on God’s Israel.

text.KJV: From henceforth let no man trouble me: for I bear in my body the marks of the Lord Jesus.
text.ASV: Henceforth, let no man trouble me; for I bear branded on my body the marks of Jesus.
text.WEB: From now on, let no one cause me any trouble, for I bear the marks of the Lord Jesus branded on my body.

text.KJV: Brethren, the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
text.ASV: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brethren. Amen.
text.WEB: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. Amen.
